message:
The emulation found no failures, and the IBM design itself is sound: every flow is connected and every component has a concrete service. It was blocked because the generator has no IBM templates for App ID, Code Engine, Cloudant, watsonx.ai or Event Notifications, and it has no reference plan for the synthetic user or the human support queue. That needs product work (new typed IBM implementations, tested with this same revision-2 project as the reproducer), not a diagram change, so I'm leaving the board as it is rather than cutting scope or switching to a storage-only contract.

While that engineering work is pending, we can still settle decisions that are ours to make: which country should the synthetic conversation data stay in, so we can later propose a matching IBM region?
